people.name: John Tovey, 1st Baron Tovey
people.nameZh: 第一代托維男爵約翰·托維

heading.en: Entry into the navy and early service

body.zh-Hant: 托維於1901年5月15日以海軍候補生身分加入皇家海軍，一個月後被派往海峽艦隊旗艦『威嚴號』戰艦。1906年7月15日晉升上尉；1908年5月18日奉派到裝甲巡洋艦『阿爾弗雷德國王號』。1913年4月2日起在『安菲翁號』服役，擔任大副，直到該艦於1914年8月6日觸雷沉沒；同年7月15日他晉升少校。
body.en: Tovey entered the Royal Navy as a midshipman on 15 May 1901 and a month later was posted to the battleship Majestic, flagship of the Channel Squadron. He was promoted Lieutenant on 15 July 1906 and was appointed to the armoured cruiser King Alfred on 18 May 1908. From 2 April 1913 he served on Amphion as first lieutenant until she was mined and sunk on 6 August 1914; he had been promoted Lieutenant-Commander on 15 July 1914.

A month later he was posted to the battleship MAJESTIC

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰驅逐艦指揮
heading.en: Destroyer commands in the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 托維在1915年1月13日獲得第一個指揮職，出任驅逐艦『傑卡爾號』艦長，該艦參加了1月24日的多格爾沙洲海戰。他其後指揮『昂斯洛號』參加5月31日的日德蘭海戰，1916年6月30日晉升中校，並於1919年獲頒傑出服務勳章（DSO）。1918年4月他接掌新驅逐艦『狼獵犬號』，同時進入驅逐艦監督官的幕僚，這些任命持續到1919年6月。
body.en: Tovey received his first command on 13 January 1915, the destroyer Jackal, which took part in the Battle of Dogger Bank on 24 January. He subsequently commanded HMS Onslow at the Battle of Jutland on 31 May, was promoted Commander on 30 June 1916, and was awarded the DSO in 1919. In April 1918 he took command of the new destroyer Wolfhound and was also appointed to the staff of the Captain Superintendent Torpedo-Boat Destroyers; these appointments lasted until June 1919.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰：地中海與本土艦隊
heading.en: The Second World War: Mediterranean and Home Fleet

body.zh-Hant: 1940年6月28日，托維指揮的第7巡洋艦分艦隊攔截了三艘執行緊急補給任務的義大利驅逐艦，即埃斯佩羅船團之戰。1940年11月，他出任本土艦隊總司令，並獲代理上將階級。館藏傳記稱，統籌追擊並擊沉『俾斯麥號』或許是他最大的成就，他也因這次作戰的傑出指揮獲頒KBE。1946年2月11日，他受封托維男爵。
body.en: On 28 June 1940 Tovey's 7th Cruiser Squadron intercepted three Italian destroyers making an urgent supply run, the Battle of the Espero Convoy. In November 1940 he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Home Fleet with the acting rank of Admiral. The museum's biography says orchestrating the pursuit and destruction of the Bismarck was perhaps his best achievement, and that he was made a KBE for his conduct in it. He was ennobled as Baron Tovey on 11 February 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 早期軍旅與英國遠征軍

body.zh-Hant: 登普西於1915年2月受任為皇家伯克郡團軍官，曾在西線服役；戰間期參與1919至1920年的伊拉克作戰，並在桑德赫斯特與南非軍事學院擔任教官。第二次世界大戰期間，他先後指揮所屬團第1營，並在1939年11月至1940年擔任英國遠征軍第13步兵旅旅長。
body.en: Dempsey was commissioned into the Royal Berkshire Regiment in February 1915 and saw active service on the Western Front. Between the wars he served in operations in Iraq in 1919–1920 and became an instructor at Sandhurst and at the South African Military College. In the Second World War he commanded the 1st Battalion of his regiment and then, from November 1939 to 1940, the 13th Infantry Brigade as part of the BEF.

saw active service on the Western Front
served in operations in Iraq 1919-1920
instructor both at Sandhurst and at the South African Military College
13th Infantry Brigade as part of the BEF (November 1939-1940)

heading.zh-Hant: 西西里、義大利與諾曼第

body.zh-Hant: 據英國國家檔案館的行政沿革，登普西在1942至1943年的西西里與義大利戰役期間指揮第13軍，並在1944至1945年指揮第2集團軍，參與諾曼第登陸與西北歐戰事。英國國防部的戰史小冊把他列為諾曼第登陸時的英軍第2集團軍司令，並寫明其部隊力圖奪取諾曼第首府卡昂。1944年8月26日，蒙哥馬利向他與克雷勒下達指令，要求奪取安特衛普港。
body.en: According to The National Archives' administrative history, Dempsey commanded 13th Corps during the campaigns for Sicily and Italy in 1942–1943 and the 2nd Army in the invasion of Normandy and north-west Europe in 1944–1945. The Ministry of Defence's anniversary booklets list him as commander of the Second (British) Army at the D-Day landings and record that his army sought to capture the Norman capital, Caen. On 26 August 1944 Montgomery issued a directive to him and Crerar that included seizing the port of Antwerp.

2nd Army in the invasion of Normandy and NW Europe (1944-1945)
SECOND (BRITISH) ARMY Lieutenant General Miles Dempsey
Dempsey’s Second (British) Army sought to capture the Norman capital, Caen.

to seize the important port of Antwerp (Belgium)

body.zh-Hant: 檔案館行政沿革記載，登普西在1945年指揮第14集團軍，負責重新佔領新加坡與馬來亞，並在1945至1946年擔任盟軍東南亞地面部隊總司令。1946年晉升上將後，他轉任中東總司令，直到1947年退休。
body.en: The administrative history records that in 1945 Dempsey commanded the 14th Army in the reoccupation of Singapore and Malaya, and that he was Commander-in-Chief of Allied Land Forces South-East Asia from 1945 to 1946. On his promotion to General in 1946 he was posted as Commander-in-Chief Middle East, until he retired in 1947.

heading.zh-Hant: 卡西諾戰役中的第8集團軍
heading.en: The Eighth Army at Monte Cassino

body.zh-Hant: 英國國防部戰史小冊記載，1944年1月12日至6月5日的蒙特卡西諾戰役中，盟軍義大利地面部隊由亞歷山大統轄，其下有克拉克中將指揮的美國第5集團軍，以及奧利弗·利斯中將指揮的英國第8集團軍。名單把利斯列在盟軍指揮官之中。
body.en: The Ministry of Defence booklet on the battles for Monte Cassino, 12 January to 5 June 1944, records that Alexander controlled the Allied armies in Italy, comprising the US Fifth Army under Lieutenant-General Mark Clark and the British Eighth Army under Lieutenant-General Sir Oliver Leese. Leese is named in its list of Allied commanders.

citations.quote: Central Italy 12 January – 5 June 1944
Alexander controlled the Allied Armies in Italy
the British Eighth Army commanded by Lieutenant-General Sir Oliver Leese
Lieutenant-General Sir Oliver Hargreaves Leese

heading.en: The thrust up the Liri Valley

body.zh-Hant: 據同一小冊，進攻計畫以利斯的第8集團軍沿6號公路進入李河谷為主攻，由英國第4師與印度第8師先建立橋頭堡，再讓英國第78師、加拿大第1師與加拿大第5裝甲師向前擴張。
body.en: According to the same booklet, the main thrust was to be by Leese's Eighth Army up the Liri Valley along Route 6, with the British 4th and Indian 8th Divisions creating a bridgehead for the British 78th, Canadian 1st and Canadian 5th Armoured Divisions to exploit.

heading.en: Allied Land Forces South East Asia

body.zh-Hant: 倫敦國王學院利德爾·哈特軍事檔案中心的館藏指南稱利斯為盟軍東南亞地面部隊（ALFSEA）總司令，並著錄他關於盟軍攻佔緬甸曼德勒之後作戰的敘述，以及東非第11師在攻佔仰光中的角色。指南另記，1945年5月他與布魯克、蒙巴頓之間往來電報，涉及撤換第14集團軍司令斯利姆的企圖。
body.en: The Liddell Hart Centre's research guide describes Leese as Commander-in-Chief, Allied Land Forces South East Asia (ALFSEA). It lists his narrative of operations following the Allied capture of Mandalay and of the role of the 11th (East African) Division in the capture of Rangoon. It also records the attempt to remove Slim from command of the 14th Army in May 1945, in which Leese exchanged telegrams with Brooke and Mountbatten.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰前與第7師、西部沙漠軍
heading.en: Pre-war posts, 7th Division and the Western Desert Force

body.zh-Hant: 館藏指南記載，奧康納在1936至1938年擔任白沙瓦旅暨白沙瓦軍區司令，1939至1940年指揮駐埃及馬特魯堡壘的第7師，1940年指揮西部沙漠軍（Western Desert Force）。
body.en: The archive guide records that O'Connor commanded the Peshawar Brigade and Peshawar District in India's North West Frontier Province in 1936–1938, commanded the 7th Division at Mersa Matruh in Egypt in 1939–1940, and commanded the Western Desert Force in 1940.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次利比亞戰役與被俘
heading.en: The First Libyan Campaign and captivity

body.zh-Hant: 同一指南著錄了與第一次利比亞戰役（1940至1941年）有關的信函、備忘錄與筆記，以及奧康納在義大利戰俘期間（1941至1943年）寫下的戰役詳細敘述。他1941年擔任駐埃及英軍總司令，之後被俘並囚於義大利的溫奇古利亞塔城堡。
body.en: The guide lists correspondence, memoranda and notes on the First Libyan campaign of 1940–1941, and O'Connor's detailed account of it written as a prisoner of war in Italy in 1941–1943. In 1941 he was General Officer Commanding-in-Chief, British Troops in Egypt, and was then captured and imprisoned in Castle Vincigliata, Italy.

body.zh-Hant: 英國國防部戰史小冊《卡昂攻勢》把第8軍軍長列為奧康納中將。1944年6月25至30日的艾普森行動，目標就是由奧康納指揮的第8軍渡過奧登河，進入卡昂以西的樹籬地帶，並進一步奪取可俯瞰卡昂南面通路的高地。
body.en: The Ministry of Defence booklet on the Drive on Caen lists Lieutenant-General Richard O'Connor as commander of VIII Corps. Operation Epsom, 25–30 June 1944, aimed to have VIII Corps under O'Connor cross the River Odon in the bocage west of Caen and push on to the high ground commanding the city's southern approaches.

body.zh-Hant: 凱斯於1885年作為不列顛尼亞號訓練艦學員進入海軍，1900年參加義和團事件的作戰，並於1905年7月1日晉升上校。
body.en: Keyes entered the Navy as a Britannia cadet in 1885, saw action in the Boxer Rebellion of 1900, and was promoted captain on 1 July 1905.

heading.zh-Hant: 一戰：潛艦、計畫部與澤布呂赫突襲
heading.en: The First World War: submarines, plans and the Zeebrugge raid

body.zh-Hant: 凱斯在1908至1910年指揮大西洋艦隊的巡洋艦『維納斯號』，1912年8月起以潛艦司令（commodore (S)）主管潛艦部隊。1916年6月他在大艦隊第二戰列艦戰隊的『百夫長號』戰艦上回到海上指揮崗位，1917年9月被任命為海軍部計畫處長。館藏說明稱他是組織1918年4月23日澤布呂赫突襲的關鍵人物，戰後隨即受封KCB。
body.en: Keyes commanded the cruiser Venus in the Atlantic Fleet in 1908–10 and in August 1912 became commodore (S) in charge of the Submarine Service. In June 1916 he returned to command at sea in the battleship Centurion of the Second Battle Squadron of the Grand Fleet, and in September 1917 he was appointed director of plans at the Admiralty. The museum text says he was instrumental in organizing the Zeebrugge raid of 23 April 1918 and was made KCB immediately afterwards.

body.zh-Hant: 館藏說明記載，凱斯在1919至1921年指揮戰鬥巡洋艦戰隊，1921至1925年任海軍副參謀長，1925至1928年任地中海艦隊總司令，1929至1931年任樸次茅斯總司令，並在1930年5月晉升海軍元帥。
body.en: The museum text records that Keyes commanded the battle-cruiser squadron in 1919–21, was deputy chief of the naval staff in 1921–25, commander-in-chief of the Mediterranean station in 1925–28 and commander-in-chief at Portsmouth in 1929–31, and was promoted admiral of the fleet in May 1930.

heading.en: MP and Director of Combined Operations

body.zh-Hant: 凱斯自1934年2月起任保守黨籍樸次茅斯北區下議員，直到1943年進入上議院。1940年7月他被任命為聯合作戰處長，直到1941年9月由蒙巴頓接替。哥倫比亞百科全書稱他任此職期間（1940至1941年）影響了兩棲作戰的早期發展，並說他在1943年被封為澤布呂赫與多佛的凱斯男爵。
body.en: Keyes was Conservative MP for Portsmouth North from February 1934 until he entered the House of Lords in 1943. He was appointed director of combined operations in July 1940 and was replaced by Lord Mountbatten in September 1941. The Columbia Encyclopedia says that as director (1940–41) he influenced the early development of amphibious warfare, and that he was raised to the peerage as Baron Keyes of Zeebrugge and Dover in 1943.

heading.zh-Hant: 多佛巡邏艦隊與澤布呂赫、奧斯坦德作戰
heading.en: Dover Patrol and the Zeebrugge and Ostend operations (1918 campaign)

body.zh-Hant: 肯特郡歷史環境紀錄載，多佛巡邏艦隊原由雷金納德·培根上將指揮，培根於 1917 年 12 月 31 日退休，由海軍中將羅傑·凱斯接任。福克斯通與海斯區議會的館藏條目稱，凱斯在 1918 年初接掌該艦隊，引入新戰術後很快取得成效，一個月內擊沉五艘德國潛艇。同一條目寫他在 4 月 23 日聖喬治節策劃了對澤布呂赫與奧斯坦德德軍潛艇基地的著名突襲；皇家格林威治博物館的館藏紀錄亦載，多佛市所贈銀盒用以紀念凱斯在 1918 年 4 月 22 至 23 日澤布呂赫與奧斯坦德突襲中的角色。澤布呂赫與奧斯坦德突襲即其任多佛巡邏艦隊指揮官期間的主要戰役。
body.en: The Kent County Council Historic Environment Record states that the Dover Patrol was commanded by Admiral Reginald Bacon until he retired on 31 December 1917, when he was succeeded by Vice-Admiral Roger Keyes. A Folkestone & Hythe District Council entry says Keyes took over the command at the start of 1918 and, by introducing new tactics, quickly achieved results, sinking five U-boats in one month. The same entry says that on St George's Day, 23 April, he masterminded the famous raids on the German submarine pens at Zeebrugge and Ostend; a Royal Museums Greenwich record adds that the silver casket presented by Dover commemorates his role in the Zeebrugge and Ostend Raids of 22-23 April 1918. These raids were the main battle action of his Dover Patrol command.
